metadata.purpose: Deterministically verify the prune/clear/lock/unlock/affected-vertices Skinning utility slice before Maya host execution.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main to include commit 8671cb0ed967001ddf14c24ebaef5eee54dfa491 or later.
No syntax failure may reach Maya live validation.
metadata.evidence: ff-only pull advanced AIMayaTool from d5c034d3e71ae0b7d630cebe7f657e0053059217 to dbb9c122fb8ce2b91459236a8537cc75537e5670; py_compile passed for utilities.py, smoke.py, and skinning __init__.py with exit code 0.

metadata.purpose: Prove lock/unlock, prune, clear-with-redistribution, and affected-vertex discovery in a disposable Maya 2024 scene.
acceptance: Launch isolated Maya 2024 without saving user scene/files.
Verify lock-all and unlock-all change liw states for all skin influences.
Verify prune removes a sub-threshold weight on a selected vertex.
Verify clear influence redistributes remaining weight and leaves the cleared influence at zero.
Verify affected_vertices includes weighted vertices and excludes the cleared influence.
metadata.diagnosis: All Skinning utility assertions completed and emitted the expected success marker. Windows exit 3221227010 occurred during Maya shutdown and matches the known shutdown anomaly; utility behavior passed.

metadata.purpose: Verify the new Skinning utility controls integrate without breaking AIMayaTool UI launch.
acceptance: Verify AIMayaToolWindow exists after utility controls are composed.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
metadata.diagnosis: Maya 2024 failed during Autodesk license checkout before bootstrap.install_and_launch executed. This is an environment/startup failure, not AIMayaTool UI evidence. Owner instruction: on this license error, close Maya and reopen it, then retry.
metadata.evidence: Maya exited 253 with ADLSDK_STATUS_LICENSE_CHECKOUT_ERROR and no AIMayaToolWindow marker.

metadata.purpose: Retry the Skinning utilities UI regression after restarting Maya following transient Autodesk license checkout failure.
acceptance: Treat ADLSDK_STATUS_LICENSE_CHECKOUT_ERROR as a transient Maya startup issue, not product failure.
Close any Maya instance/process left from the failed launch, then reopen Maya 2024 for this retry.
Run bootstrap.install_and_launch in an isolated Maya session and verify AIMayaToolWindow exists.
A successful AIMayaToolWindow marker is functional acceptance even if the known Maya shutdown anomaly recurs.
